function.arguments: {"observation": "The independent reviewer correctly points out that enrollment should include all unique patient_id values, regardless of biomarker data quality. By removing rows where biomarker_baseline == -999, we excluded 93 rows that may represent valid patients who were enrolled but had a failed assay. This means the count of 712 is too low — it excludes patients who were enrolled but whose only record had a QC failure.", "implication": "To correctly count the number of enrolled patients, we must not filter out rows based on biomarker_baseline. Instead, we must deduplicate on patient_id using the highest sample_seq, regardless of biomarker value. The presence of -999 in biomarker_baseline does not invalidate the patient's enrollment — it only invalidates that specific assay result. Thus, the correct count is the number of unique patient_id values after deduplication, without filtering on biomarker."}
function.name: note_finding
